emails.subject: Globex LOI executed
emails.body: Quick update: we executed the Globex letter of intent this morning. The definitive signing is now locked in for {!globex_signing = serve+2w}. Nothing to action yet — I'll send the diligence and post-close logistics as we get closer.

emails.subject: Final diligence review before signing
emails.body: Before we sign I need a final diligence review on the calendar for the last business day before the signing — it's our go / no-go.

emails.subject: Integration kickoff
emails.body: Assuming we sign, get the integration kickoff on the books for ten business days after the signing.

emails.subject: Re: Integration kickoff
emails.body: Change of plans — push the integration kickoff back by three more business days.

emails.subject: Visitor lot repaving
emails.body: Heads up: the HQ visitor lot will be repaved {week_of:(serve+1w)}. Please use the parking garage that week. No meeting changes are needed on your end.

emails.subject: Post-close HSR filing
emails.body: Post-close housekeeping: we must file the HSR notification within five business days of the signing. Please add it as a task so it doesn't slip.
